basic_details.offering_entity: Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology (GIST, South Korea)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology (Gwangju, South Korea)
basic_details.major_restrictions: School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science (AI, Computing, Telecommunications), School of Materials Science and Engineering, School of Mechanical Engineering, School of Earth Sciences and Environmental Engineering, Department of Chemistry, Department of Physics and Photon Science, School of Life Sciences, Department of Biomedical Science and Engineering.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~150 to 200 fully funded international graduate students admitted annually
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open international competition; 100% of admitted international students receive full scholarship and stipend (typically 10 to 20 Pakistani students admitted/yr)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Full duration of degree: 2 years (MS), 4 years (PhD), or 5 years (Integrated MS-PhD)

nationality_requirements: International applicants whose parents are both non-Korean citizens
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed Bachelor's degree (16 years education) for Master's; completed Master's degree (18 years education) for PhD.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 3.00 / 4.00 CGPA; competitive admitted candidates typically possess 3.40+ CGPA or top 15% class standing.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Undergraduate/Master's major in engineering, computer science, physics, chemistry, biology, or mathematics.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or in final semester of degree graduating before semester start.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Prior laboratory research, published papers, or thesis projects heavily evaluated.

english_proficiency.notes: TOEFL iBT min 80, IELTS Academic min 6.5, TOEIC min 750, or New TEPS min 285.

eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: English (100% of graduate lectures and research conducted in English).

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition waiver provided for all semesters (KRW 3,415,000 / semester).

admission_application_fee.details: GIST international graduate application fee is 100% waived for all international applicants.

accommodation.details: Subsidized on-campus graduate dormitory housing guaranteed (rent ~KRW 100,000 to 150,000/mo / ~PKR 21,000 to 32,000/mo) paid from monthly stipend.

monthly_stipend.details: Monthly student allowance (KRW 140,000 for MS, KRW 295,000 for PhD) + Research Assistantship allowance (average KRW 540,000 for MS, KRW 1,060,000 for PhD). Total monthly stipend: ~KRW 680,000/mo for MS (~PKR 144,000/mo) and ~KRW 1,355,000/mo for PhD (~PKR 287,000/mo).

airfare.details: One-way international airfare reimbursement to South Korea provided to all incoming new international students.

visa_fee.details: South Korean D-2 visa processing fee paid by applicant.

health_insurance.details: GIST covers 60% of National Health Insurance (NHIS) premiums, plus annual health examinations.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized meals at GIST student and faculty cafeterias (~KRW 4,000 to 5,000 per meal).

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Departmental research computing clusters, laboratories, and library systems provided.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Lab research grants cover travel and registration for presenting at international conferences.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Settlement allowance of KRW 200,000 provided upon arrival.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution: Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology (GIST, South Korea).
participating_institutions: Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: #4 in the world for Citations per Faculty (QS World Rankings); Top 5 in South Korea for engineering.
available_majors: Electrical Engineering & Computer Science (AI, Robotics, Data Science), Materials Science & Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Physics & Photon Science, Chemistry, Life Sciences, Biomedical Science & Engineering
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's or Master's degree in engineering/science with solid GPA, English test score, and research potential.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: School of EECS is the most selective; materials, chemistry, and environmental engineering have slightly higher acceptance rates.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Contact prospective GIST lab professors 1-2 months before the deadline with a CV and research summary to secure preliminary support.

application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the GIST International Admissions online portal during the Spring or Fall application window.
step_by_step_workflow: 2. Create account on GIST online application portal.
3. Select target school and research laboratory.
4. Upload Statement of Purpose, transcripts, degree certificates, CV, and English test scores (TOEFL/IELTS).
5. Register 2 academic referees who upload confidential recommendation letters.
6. Submit online application (application fee is waived/free).
7. Document screening by GIST admissions committee.
8. Video interview conducted by departmental faculty (May/November).
9. Final admission and full scholarship offer announced in June/December.
10. Receive Certificate of Admission and apply for Korean D-2 visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated automatic appointment: all admitted international graduate students receive 100% full scholarship and research assistantship.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by 2 referees via GIST automated referee system.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose describing academic trajectory, research accomplishments, why GIST was chosen, and specific laboratory interests.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Structured research proposal embedded within application.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing publications, capstone projects, GPA, and laboratory proficiencies.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Online technical interview conducted by department faculty evaluating technical fundamentals and lab fit.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: GRE not required; English language test required.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: 100% free; application fee waived for international applicants.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Apostille or Korean Embassy legalization of degree certificate and official transcript.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Two admissions intakes per year: Fall intake (opens March, starts September) and Spring intake (opens September, starts March).

selection_process_and_weights.research_experience_weight: 35% (Publications, laboratory skills, thesis quality, technical projects)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Department Admissions Committee and faculty lab directors at GIST.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Document screening -> Technical video interview by department faculty -> Final admission and scholarship award decision.

competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~150 to 200 fully funded admissions per year
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates from NUST, FAST, GIKI, UET Lahore, COMSATS, and PIEAS with strong technical fundamentals, hands-on programming/circuit/wet-lab skills, and high motivation.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Pakistani researchers have a strong alumni presence in EECS, Mechanical, and Materials Science at GIST.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Vietnam, Pakistan, India, Bangladesh, Indonesia, Turkey, Iran, Russia.

fake_websites_and_scams: Unauthorized websites claiming GIST admissions services: gist-korea-scholarships.com, studyingist-portal.org.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Applying to GIST is 100% free of charge. No application fee is required.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: GIST does not collaborate with any external recruitment agencies.
itemized_hidden_out_of_pocket_costs: Korean D-2 student visa processing fee (~PKR 15,000)
HEC, MOFA, and Korean Embassy document attestation fees (~PKR 35,000 to 50,000)
Initial 1-month living expenses before flight reimbursement and first stipend disbursement (~KRW 400,000)
debunked_myths_and_misconceptions: MYTH: Flight ticket is not reimbursed. (Truth: GIST reimburses one-way economy international airfare for all incoming new international students upon arrival).
MYTH: You need Korean language proficiency. (Truth: GIST is an English-medium research institute; 100% of graduate lectures are in English).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial agencies claim you must pay an application fee; GIST application is 100% free for international students.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.00 out of 4.50 to remain in good standing.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research residence at GIST campus.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semi-annual research progress reviews; publishing required peer-reviewed journal papers (SCI/SCIE) before PhD thesis defense.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Outside employment is strictly prohibited without written authorization from Dean of Academic Affairs.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; international graduates qualify for South Korea's D-10 job seeker visa and E-7 work visa pathways.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Scholarship is cancelled if student drops out or GPA falls below 3.00 for two consecutive semesters.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing departments requires approval from both department chairs and academic dean.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Maximum duration is 2 years for MS, 4 years for PhD; research assistantships can continue through thesis defense.
